acceptanceCriteria: The cause is named (module layout, missing `go.mod` at the snapshot root, vendoring, or a gopls version limit) with a repro on one caddy and one etcd snapshot, and either the bench snapshots are prepared so gopls loads them or the TCP-V0-046 reading is re-labelled as measured with no gopls contribution on those repositories.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent reviews of the V1 wave-3 pull requests. Review of PR #98 (V1-0099): with real gopls on the bench snapshot caddyserver__caddy@aed1af59 all 39 of 39 queries returned 'no package metadata for file'; after the review fix such runs are reported `unavailable`. The V1-0099 BUILD-LOG recount shows 22 of 59 `loaded` runs with at least one relation; the 37 empty ones are caddy 13, etcd 23 and gin 1. Why gopls cannot load these snapshots was not investigated, so the TCP-V0-046 off/on numbers on those repositories measure the packet without any gopls contribution.
title: lspprovider: gopls answers `no package metadata for file` for every query on 37 of 59 loaded bench snapshots
